retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle shot of a curved industrial roof against a vast, cyan-tinted sky with right-aligned, heavy condensed typography.
excludeWhen: centered or symmetrical compositions are requested
ornate or serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, cyan-toned photograph featuring a corrugated, curved industrial roof in the lower third, looking up at a cloudy sky with a small bird silhouette and bold, right-justified condensed text.
coreVisualRelationships: The curved roof line creates a strong diagonal anchor in the bottom half.
The vast sky provides a large field of negative space for the typography.
The right-aligned text block balances the leftward curve of the roof.
The cyan color cast unifies the industrial and natural elements.
coreInvariants: Cyan-dominant color grading with heavy vignetting.
Low-angle perspective looking up at a curved structure.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The industrial roof occupies the bottom 40% of the frame; the sky occupies the top 60%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, shadowed curve of the roof in the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the roof from bottom left to middle right, then moves upward to the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the sky area, particularly on the left side.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (Roof shadows and top text lines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Grey-Blue (Bottom text lines and roof highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep blacks in the corners and bright, desaturated cyan in the center sky.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'c' and 'e' have very small apertures
Lowercase 'r' has a short, blunt shoulder
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with varying opacity and color for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and narrow width.
Provides the necessary industrial, condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of a curved, corrugated metal roof with visible rivets, set against a cloudy sky. Apply a heavy cyan/teal color grade and a dark vignette around the edges. Include a tiny silhouette of a bird in the mid-left sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of right-aligned, extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in the upper right. The top two lines should be solid black; the bottom two lines should be a semi-transparent grey-blue.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette dominated by cyan and black?
Is the roof curved and positioned at the bottom?
Is the font extra-condensed and lowercase?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the lower text lines
mustRedesign: Any use of bright warm colors like red or orange

mustAchieve: Strong industrial texture on the roof

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the edges of the frame.
Verify the cyan tint is consistent across the sky.
Check that the roof rivets are visible but not distracting.
Confirm the right-alignment of all text lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Architecture + Cyan Color Grade + Right-Aligned Condensed Type
